purpose: Operator-owned Sprint 03 still-image validation inputs for non-biometric appearance descriptors.

notes: Download media only for local validation when license and attribution requirements are acceptable to the operator.
Do not commit downloaded images, cropped people, or derived personal media.
Record local paths and command output in an audit receipt if a validation run is performed.

bbox_guidance: Use a manually selected person bounding box around the visible person for local still-image validation.
Prefer full-body boxes when checking headwear, lower clothing, and footwear.
If an image is cropped, occluded, blurry, or not suitable for the descriptor being checked, record it as unsuitable instead of forcing a descriptor.

sources.candidate_file: HK people boy wearing hat September 2024 R12S 01.jpg
expected_checks: headwear is not forced to unknown when the hat region is visible
upper clothing color remains coarse and non-identifying

continuity confidence is not inferred from a standalone source image
